India Cricket Team Prepares for Sri Lanka Test Series

The Indian cricket team is preparing to face Sri Lanka in an upcoming Test series. Spinners are expected to face challenges due to crosswinds at the Galle venue, influenced by its proximity to the ocean. Players like Shubman Gill have expressed confidence in their captaincy and set goals for the World Test Championship. The team is also considering KL Rahul's experience to adapt to the conditions. Sri Lanka's captain has defended the recall of a player ahead of the match.
